summary_1line: Uma asks Shiva about the duties and practices of forest recluses and ascetics, and Shiva describes their severe disciplines, rituals, virtues, and spiritual rewards.

image_candidates.scene_text: An emaciated forest ascetic sits in meditation surrounded by four blazing fires under the blazing summer sun while wearing bark garments.
Tiny thumb-sized Valkhilya sages glow with radiance as they dwell within the solar disc.
A hermit in the forest gathers fallen leaves and moss for food while deer graze peacefully around him.
